text:
maria: Starting a thread to coordinate the us-west-3 GPU region bring-up. We need a concise runbook + CICD wiring for Terraform infra modules and Pulumi application stacks. Main asks: where to put state, locking, bootstrap pipeline, preflight checks, quota requests, and cost guardrails.

ajay: TL;DR: central per-region state bucket with per-team prefixes. Terraform backend (S3) + DynamoDB for locks. Pulumi can use the same S3 backend with a backend url. Keep service accounts ephemeral in CI.

jamie: Terraform backend example (copy into module root):
```hcl
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "redwood-state-us-west-3"
    key    = "eng-infra/us-west-3/terraform.tfstate"
    region = "us-west-3"
    dynamodb_table = "redwood-tf-locks"
    encrypt = true
  }
}
```

sujin: CI env var names we standardised on: `TF_STATE_BUCKET`, `TF_LOCK_TABLE`, `PULUMI_BACKEND_URL`. Pipeline should retrieve temporary creds via workload identity / short-lived SA. Also: ensure KMS key policy allows CI SA to encrypt state.

maria: Minimal preflight checklist (to include in runbook):
- quotas requested (GPUs, vCPUs, IP addresses)
- subnet CIDR plan (no overlap with existing peered regions)
- KMS key created and IAM bound
- route tables / NAT / egress validated for model artifacts
- bastion/management plane decision (private bastion vs SSM)
- cost estimate <= budget threshold / daily burn guardrail

ajay: Add a small validation script that runs as a CI job before provisioning. Example output below. If any check fails, pipeline should alert and stop.
```bash
# preflight.sh --region us-west-3
Checking quotas... OK (32 GPUs available)
CIDR collisions... OK
IAM roles... MISSING: infra/region-deployer
```

jamie: For state migrations (renames or module splits) include a `state-migration` job in the pipeline that runs `terraform state mv` under a locked window. Keep PRs tiny and include `apply` hold for manual operator.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: infra-us-west-3-bootstrap #234 (started by ajay)

sujin: I put a draft handoff doc in the internal wiki: https://redwood.internal/wiki/region/us-west-3-bootstrap — includes runbook skeleton and cost estimate. :thumbsup:

maria: Operator handoff steps (final section of runbook):
1) Confirm quota ticket approved and quota numbers in console
2) Run CI preflight; fix any missing IAM / CIDR issues
3) Trigger bootstrap pipeline (infra-us-west-3-bootstrap) and watch lock table
4) Validate cluster nodes come up and GPU driver install logs are green
5) Run smoke model inference test and evaluate latency/cost numbers
6) Mark region as `available` and update onboarding doc

ajay: I'll open the PR with backend + sample pipeline today, include a `preflight.sh` job and state-migration stub. Aiming EOD. cc @eng-sre

maria: Perfect — I'll coordinate the quota ticket and add the cost guardrails to the pipeline (deny apply if estimated burn > $X/day). Ping @oncall if preflight fails. :rocket:
